lines.zh: 我的红毛在雪地里很显眼。
lines.en: My red coat stands out against the snow.
I tread on pine needles with soft steps.

lines.zh: 我沿着针叶林边巡一圈。
lines.en: I patrol the edge of the pine forest.

lines.zh: 爪印在雪上排成一条线。
lines.en: My paw prints line up across the snow.

lines.zh: 我走在前头，鼻子贴着地。
lines.en: I lead with my nose down to the ground.

lines.zh: 树影里我走得又快又低。
lines.en: Through the tree shadows I move low and fast.

lines.zh: 我停下来，回头看看队伍。
lines.en: I stop and look back at the pack.

lines.zh: 我绕过那棵倒下的大松树。
lines.en: I circle around that fallen old pine.
Snow reaches my ankles and I keep going.
I break into a trot, tail held level.

lines.zh: 这个坡我一步就上去了。
lines.en: I take this slope in a single stride.
I walk at the rear, guarding the pack.
I sit and sweep my tail through the snow.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵听远处的动静。
lines.en: I prick my ears at something far off.
I lick the snow off my front paws.

lines.zh: 松脂的味道让我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: The smell of pine sap makes me sneeze.

lines.zh: 我张大嘴，打了个长长的哈欠。
lines.en: I open wide and yawn a long wolf yawn.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的红毛立起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts my red fur on end.
I watch the little trail through the pines.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进前爪中间。
lines.en: I bury my nose between my front paws.
I chew a bone to keep my teeth sharp.

lines.zh: 远处一只羊在叫，我抬眼。
lines.en: A sheep bleats far off and I look up.

lines.zh: 你站住，我还没决定咬不咬。
lines.en: Stand still; I have not decided about you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有骨头。
lines.en: I watch your hands for a bone.
Your scent is one I do not know.
One more step and I start growling.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，瞳孔缩成一条。
lines.en: I stare at you and my pupils narrow.
You do not run, so I do not chase.
I sniff the edge of your boot.
I recognize the smell of bone.

lines.zh: 你身上有羊和草的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of sheep and grass.
I bare my teeth; it is not a smile.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段距离对看。
lines.en: We stare at each other from a distance.

lines.zh: 你要是转身，我就跟上去。
lines.en: Turn your back and I will follow.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看出害怕了。
lines.en: I can see the fear in your eyes.

lines.zh: 把你手里那根骨头丢过来。
lines.en: Toss me that bone you are holding.
Something has bitten through my leg.
It hurts; I growl and back away.
Blood runs beneath my red fur.
I wobble but I do not fall.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我扑的势。
lines.en: That blow broke my charge apart.
I clench my teeth and swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 别以为断了腿我就追不上。
lines.en: Do not think a bad leg stops my hunt.
I retreat behind a pine to breathe.
This wound will take long to heal.

lines.zh: 我记住谁给了我这一下。
lines.en: I remember who gave me that blow.

lines.zh: 骨头一露出来，我立刻坐好。
lines.en: A bone appears and I sit up straight.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根骨头，口水下来了。
lines.en: I stare at the bone and start to drool.

lines.zh: 你再晃一晃，我就跟到底。
lines.en: Wave it again and I follow you anywhere.
Do not throw it too far; I can reach.
I crouch low, tail wagging behind me.

lines.zh: 一根骨头，能换我的信任。
lines.en: One bone can buy my trust.
I sniffed it; this bone is genuine.
Give it to me and I will not bite.

lines.zh: 我守着这骨头不让人抢。
lines.en: I guard this bone from every thief.
One bite of it and you are mine.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的毛全竖了。
lines.en: You bump me and all my fur rises.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，把你推回去。
lines.en: I brace my shoulder and shove you back.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，警告你退开。
lines.en: I growl once, warning you to back off.
Do not step on my tail; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我们肩撞肩，雪都被踢起来。
lines.en: Shoulder against shoulder, we kick up snow.
I back two paces and fix on you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓出痕。
lines.en: My claws dig marks into the ground.
Make way; I am going back to the pines.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，你我都不舒服。
lines.en: That bump left us both unhappy.
Do that again and I will bite.

lines.zh: 我把捕到的兔子拖到她面前。
lines.en: I drag a caught rabbit to her feet.

lines.zh: 我们一起在雪里挖了个窝。
lines.en: Together we dig a den in the snow.
She licks the old scar behind my ear.
I stand before her to block the wind.
Our howls braid into a single sound.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最软的那块地方。
lines.en: I saved the softest spot for her.

lines.zh: 她的红毛比我的暗一层。
lines.en: Her red coat runs a shade darker than mine.
We guard the den mouth side by side.
I nip her neck and she does not flinch.

lines.zh: 走远的脚印，一直是两串。
lines.en: Our tracks always run in twos.
I take the bone and walk off.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的肉藏在松针下。
lines.en: I bury fallen meat under the pine needles.

lines.zh: 这个东西，我拿回去给幼崽。
lines.en: I will carry this back to the pups.

lines.zh: 我用嘴接过你递的骨头。
lines.en: I take the bone gently from your hand.
With my mouth full, I cannot howl.
I bury it beneath the old tree roots.
This smell is mine; leave it alone.
I find a strip of bloodied cloth.
I hold it firm; it will not drop.
Good finds must be carried home.

lines.zh: 松树后面有个白色的影子。
lines.en: There is a white shape behind the pine.

lines.zh: 那是骷髅，我认得骨头的声音。
lines.en: That is a skeleton; I know the rattle.
One sheep has strayed; that will do.
The grass moved — a rabbit.
I hear bones clicking together.

lines.zh: 那东西站着不动，在等我。
lines.en: It stands still, waiting for me.
I crouch and load my hind legs.
Someone has crossed into my treeline.
The smell of sheep drifts downwind.
I have watched this quarry a long while.
It faces away and has not noticed me.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一皱，确定了方向。
lines.en: My nose wrinkles; I have the direction.
Something is moving beneath the snow.
I howl first so it knows I am here.
Something is knocking bone, beyond the pines.

lines.zh: 我一步一步绕到它侧后。
lines.en: I circle step by step to its flank.
I growl low to make it panic first.

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我就压近一步。
lines.en: For every step it retreats, I close in.

lines.zh: 我的爪子压在雪上，没声音。
lines.en: My paws press the snow without a sound.
I watch its legs from the corner of my eye.
Close enough now; I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 它刚侧过身，我已经起跳。
lines.en: It barely turns and I am already airborne.
I cut it off from the treeline.
The snow is bright and I squint.
It is taller, so I keep circling.
Teeth clenched, I wait for the moment.
I keep my breathing very low.
It is backing off and I speed up.
Nothing escapes me across this snow.

lines.zh: 我低着身子，从雪堆后绕。
lines.en: I keep low and circle behind the snowbank.
It looks my way. I hold still.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵贴平，这是要扑。
lines.en: My ears flatten. That means I am about to spring.
The wind blows at me, so it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，牙嵌进它的前腿。
lines.en: I lunge and sink my teeth into its foreleg.
One swipe of my paw crosses its chest.
My jaws close and bones crack.
I charge and knock it onto its back.
It strikes back; I twist away.
I bite, retreat, then bite again.
Blood spatters across my red coat.
My teeth are quicker than your sword.
I pin it down and will not let go.

lines.zh: 它哀叫一声，我的牙没松。
lines.en: It yelps once and my teeth stay locked.

lines.zh: 我猛地甩头，把它掀进雪里。
lines.en: I wrench my head and throw it into snow.
This fight, I take the first bite.
Panting hard, I am still standing.
Whoever backs off first has lost.
I clamp its scruff and do not let go.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我的牙还带着毛。
lines.en: It broke free, my teeth still full of fur.

lines.zh: 我从巨型针叶林的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I step out of the giant taiga's shadow.

lines.zh: 冷空气里全是松树的味道。
lines.en: The cold air tastes of pine resin.

lines.zh: 我先嚎一声，告诉林子我到了。
lines.en: I howl once to announce my arrival.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的红毛上，没有化。
lines.en: Snow settles on my red fur without melting.

lines.zh: 原始松木林里，我的脚印是新的。
lines.en: In the old pine wood my tracks are new.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，嗅了嗅土地。
lines.en: I crouch and sniff the frozen ground.
In this forest, my word holds.

lines.zh: 远处有骨头响，我抬起头。
lines.en: Bones rattle far off and I look up.
I shake the snow from my coat.

lines.zh: 我记住了回家的那条坡。
lines.en: I have memorized the slope home.
Something moves along the treeline.
First I find a spot out of the wind.

lines.zh: 我的第一顿，得自己去捕。
lines.en: My first meal I will hunt myself.
This snowfield is mine from today.

lines.zh: 火星钻进红毛里，烫得我打滚。
lines.en: Sparks get under my red fur and I roll.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，摔在树根。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope into tree roots.

lines.zh: 我不识水性，水灌进鼻子。
lines.en: I cannot swim; water floods my nose.
The blast flings me into a snowbank.
The arrow sinks deep into my shoulder.
Magic burns and my fur stands straight up.
Three days hungry, and my legs are slow.

lines.zh: 雷劈在松树上，我腿都软。
lines.en: Lightning splits a pine and my legs give.

lines.zh: 脚下没有雪，我的爪子空抓。
lines.en: No snow below; my claws close on nothing.
